description: zeugnis: denies a second or out-of-scope source edit while a zeugnis-remediator remediation scope is open, and a Bash command that would install, publish or run a mutation tool in write mode. type:command, never type:prompt. Inert until analysis/zeugnis/ exists in the repo (the edit guard additionally needs an open analysis/zeugnis/remediation_scope.json), and bypassed per call by ZEUGNIS_DISABLE_GUARD=1.
